brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported that Israeli Occupation Forces continue conducting attacks on inhabited homes and civilian gatherings across Gaza, killing entire families inside their residences. The group documented a pattern of escalating strikes on homes, civilian assemblies, and displacement tents throughout the territory over an ongoing period.

The centre characterized the repeated operations as targeting Palestinians for extermination, citing the killing of family members within their dwellings as systematic. The rights organisation said the recurring nature of such attacks on civilians demonstrates a consistent approach by Israeli forces across multiple locations in the Gaza Strip.
dek: The Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) continue to commit crimes against Palestinian civilians in the Gaza Strip by escalating attacks on inhabited homes, civilian gatherings, and displacement tents across the Gaza Strip, exterminating entire Palestinian families and killing their members inside their homes. title: Israeli strikes kill Palestinian families in Gaza homes, rights group says
